papers.title: Physical computing across magnetic and RF domains for passive wireless information retrieval
papers.summary: A passive physical computing system that transforms local magnetic signals directly into RF backscatter, retrieving magnetic information wirelessly without on-device digital signal processing.

papers.title: Event-based Visible Light Backscatter Communication System in Underwater Environment
papers.summary: An underwater communication system that combines liquid-crystal polarization modulation with event-camera decoding for low-power data links in underwater IoT.

preview.alt: Underwater visible light backscatter system showing the light source, event camera, submerged tag, and event-stream decoding pipeline.

papers.title: Mechanically programmable metasurface for ultralow-power subterahertz beam steering
papers.summary: A mechanically programmable metasurface that steers sub-terahertz beams through its surface geometry, holding beam states without power for continuous steering and tracking.

papers.title: A low-power single-channel EEG sensor for fatigue monitoring and command interaction
papers.summary: A lightweight single-channel EEG sensor that combines dry electrodes, low-power backscatter, and neural reconstruction for fatigue monitoring and hands-free command interaction.

papers.title: A magneto-mechanical bio-interface with ultra-low-power analog backscatter for inclusive cardiac monitoring
papers.summary: A wearable bio-interface that converts heart-induced skin micro-vibrations into magnetic signals and transmits them via analog backscatter for low-power cardiac monitoring.

papers.title: Mighty: Towards Long-Range and High-Throughput Backscatter for Drones
papers.summary: Mighty pairs a low-power backscatter radio with a lightweight video pipeline that shifts heavy processing to the ground controller, cutting the energy cost of long-range drone video streaming.

directions.title: Embodied Intelligence of Things
directions.subtitle: Robots, Human Motion, and Physical-World Sensing

papers.title: mmExpert: Integrating Large Language Models for Comprehensive mmWave Data Synthesis and Understanding
papers.summary: mmExpert is a scalable framework that generates diverse mmWave-language data from the world knowledge of large language models and enables open-vocabulary mmWave understanding through language-aligned pre-training and a versatile interpreter.

papers.title: Privacy Preserving Two Hand Reconstruction Using Millimeter Wave Radar for Sign Language Understanding
papers.summary: mmPRISM reconstructs two-hand skeletal poses from raw 4D millimeter-wave radar and feeds them to a large language model for privacy-preserving, open-vocabulary sign language understanding.
